definitions.gloss: fast walking; brisk walking; walking quickly
definitions.explanation: Walking at a pace faster than normal, either to get somewhere quickly or as a form of exercise.

examples.japanese: ⟦{駅|えき}→駅：02180_eki⟧⟦まで→まで：00490_made⟧{早歩|はやある}き⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{行|い}った→行く：00119_iku⟧。
examples.english: I walked briskly to the station.

examples.japanese: {早歩|はやある}き⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{健康|けんこう}→健康：02706_kenkou⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦いい→いい：00118_ii⟧⟦{運動|うんどう}→運動：00821_undou⟧だ。
examples.english: Brisk walking is good exercise for your health.

examples.japanese: ⟦{遅刻|ちこく}→遅刻：03465_chikoku⟧しそうだった⟦の→の：09472_no⟧で{早歩|はやある}き⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{会社|かいしゃ}→会社：00607_kaisha⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{向|む}かった→向かう：01186_mukau⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧、⟦{結局|けっきょく}→結局：03815_kekkyoku⟧⟦{走|はし}る→走る：00519_hashiru⟧ことになった。
examples.english: I was about to be late, so I walked briskly toward the office, but ended up running.

notes:
A compound of ⟦{早|はや}い→早い：00514_hayai⟧ (fast) and ⟦{歩|ある}き→歩く：00538_aruku⟧ (walking). Functions as a noun and can be used adverbially with で ({早歩|はやある}き⟦で→で：00502_de⟧). Commonly promoted as a health exercise, especially for older adults.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {早歩|はやある}き⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{行|い}く→行く：00119_iku⟧: to go at a brisk walk
- {早歩|はやある}き⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to walk fast
- {早歩|はやある}き⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{効果|こうか}→効果：02726_kouka⟧: benefits of brisk walking
- {早歩|はやある}き⟦{散歩|さんぽ}→散歩：02885_sanpo⟧: brisk walking (as exercise)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {速足|はやあし}: quick pace — often written with different kanji, slightly more literary
- ⟦{小走|こばし}り→小走り：21117_kobashiri⟧: light jog, trot — faster than walking but not quite running
- ⟦ウォーキング→ウォーキング：05240_wookingu⟧: walking (as exercise) — loanword, commonly used in fitness contexts
